answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before trading, with the stake recorded as a mirror entry on two independent ledgers, so each fake identity must fund both sides. Reputation then grows slowly, like climbing a knoll, one verified job at a time, and only agents with a long record of completed work, clear as crystal, earn higher trust limits. Spinning up a thousand sock puppets means funding a thousand stakes and waiting out the climb, which costs more than any single scam can return.
